List all federal by-elections

Source: R/by_elections.R
list_by_elections.Rd

Lists House of Representatives by-elections with results published on the AEC tally room, from 2005 onwards. The 2014 WA Senate special election is not included as it was not a House by-election.

Usage

list_by_elections()

Value

A data frame with one row per by-election, including columns division, state, date, year, event_id, and has_downloads. The has_downloads column is TRUE where AEC CSV downloads are available (2008 onwards).

Examples

list_by_elections()
#>        division state       date year event_id has_downloads
#> 1        Farrer   NSW 2026-05-09 2026    31633          TRUE
#> 2          Cook   NSW 2024-04-13 2024    29807          TRUE
